snippet.title: PVKK | Gamescom Teleradio Trailer
snippet.description:
Greetings Commanders.

PVKK is a planetary defence game where you're tasked with defending your home from the constant threat of invasion. At your disposal is a massive interplanetary defence cannon, perfectly suited to light up the skies with a variety of munition types. Receive your orders from the handy Teleradio, where your assigned Disposition Officer is on hand to help! You're here to do a job and serve the Cooperative State of Antos proudly! And please, drink your health giving tea.

PVKK is launching Summer 2026, which you can Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956040/PVKK_Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant/
